title: comment.added.v1
description: A comment was added. Written to the comments service outbox in the same transaction as the comment; delivered to each subscriber (likes, lake) as a separate row. The comment text is never published, only its length. Topic name: comment.added.v1; partition key: videoId. Compatibility: only adding optional fields.

eventId.description: Event ID; the consumer deduplicates by it and by commentId.

traceId.description: W3C trace id; may be absent.

authorId.description: Keycloak sub of the comment author.

videoOwnerId.description: Keycloak sub of the video owner.

textLength.description: Length of the comment text in characters.
